# `?` — Predicate

Syntax. Hanzi: `若`

In a dfn, `C?` ends a predicate. When `C` is true, the rest of the body runs. When it's false, the dfn moves on to its next body, after `;`.

```bpl
{ω<0?-ω;ω}¯3      ⍝ 3
{ω<0?-ω;ω}4       ⍝ 4
```

Statements before a predicate run first. After it, a body can run several statements, or hold more predicates.

```bpl
{ω<0?a←-ω ◇ a×2;ω}¯3   ⍝ 6
{ω>0?ω<10?ω;0}15       ⍝ 0
```

`C` must be a Boolean singleton. A body that ends after its predicate returns no result. If every predicate fails, the call is a `DOMAIN` error. See [Dfns](../dfns.ipynb).
